review.body:
<!-- factory-judge-review round=2 -->
### Factory judge · round 2 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — stops.test.ts first case: the only change is a suppression-shaped line in packages/action/dist/index.js, and it asserts no protected_path stops.
- A2: met — generated-suppressions.test.ts first case: diff.no-new-suppressions passes with the bundle in `generated`. tier1.ts now computes and passes `generated`.
- A3: met — stops.test.ts third case asserts a protected_path stop for src/a.ts. generated-suppressions.test.ts second case asserts diff.no-new-suppressions fails and findProtected flags src/b.ts.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Generated-path skip may trust the change's own .gitattributes `packages/runtime/src/judge/tier1.ts:163` — For the suppression skip, resolve linguist-generated against the base's `.gitattributes`, or treat a change to `.gitattributes` as protected. Add a test where `.gitattributes` and the suppression arrive in the same commit.
- Bundle comment no longer sits next to the line it explains `packages/runtime/src/agent/stops.ts:235` — Move the comment above the `generated` declaration and make it cover both the suppression and secret checks.

</details>

_Not reviewed: `packages/action/dist/SOURCE_SHA256` (generated), `packages/action/dist/index.js` (generated)._

suggestions.title: Generated-path skip may trust the change's own .gitattributes
suggestions.detail: Both suppression checks now skip anything `generatedPaths` calls generated, and that includes `linguist-generated` files. If `generatedPaths` reads `.gitattributes` from the head or worktree, a change can mark its own source as generated. The deterministic suppression gate then goes quiet. `.gitattributes` isn't a protected path. The task card asks for linguist-generated to be skipped, and the new tests only put `.gitattributes` in the base commit, so whether this happens depends on `generatedPaths` code that isn't in this diff.
suggestions.repro: If attributes are read at head: one change adds `.gitattributes` with `src/** linguist-generated` and adds an eslint-disable line to `src/a.ts`. findStops raises no protected_path stop, and diff.no-new-suppressions passes.
suggestions.fix: For the suppression skip, resolve linguist-generated against the base's `.gitattributes`, or treat a change to `.gitattributes` as protected. Add a test where `.gitattributes` and the suppression arrive in the same commit.

suggestions.title: Bundle comment no longer sits next to the line it explains
suggestions.detail: `generated` is now declared above `findProtected`. The comment that explains why generated paths are skipped stayed below, next to the secret loop, so the protected-path use has no comment.
suggestions.fix: Move the comment above the `generated` declaration and make it cover both the suppression and secret checks.
